description: Activated balancing energy prices per quarter hour (Historical data - up to 22/05/2024) is a dataset listed in Elia open data platform, an open data platform of a transmission system operator, published or maintained by Elia Group. Price of energy activated to maintain a balance in Elia’s control area to ensure adequacy in the Elia control area. The prices per quart-hour are indicated for every product category (if the product was actually used). Coverage: Belgium. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Balancing. Its keywords are Activation. The portal shows 2025-06-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Elia Open Data Licence (/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-elia-open-data-portal.
